jobs.description:
Job Description

AI Architect

Location:

London (Hybrid)

Contract Duration:

6 Months

Daily Rate:

£680 per day

Clearance:

Active SC Clearance Required

Role Overview

We are seeking a AI Architect to lead the design, governance, and delivery of enterprise-grade AI solutions built on frontier foundation models.

This is a high-impact, hybrid technical-leadership contract position. You will architect solutions that push what frontier models including LLMs, multi-modal systems, and agentic architectures can responsibly achieve within complex, highly regulated environments. You will lead a team of architects and engineers while serving as a trusted technical advisor to client CxOs.

Key Responsibilities

Architecture and Solution Design: Architect enterprise AI solutions using frontier models (Claude, GPT, Gemini family) across agentic automation, RAG, copilots, and multi-modal applications.
Pre-Sales and Discovery: Lead technical solutioning during pre-sales and discovery, translating client business challenges into scalable AI architectures and delivery roadmaps.
Platform Governance: Design and govern AI platform architecturescovering model orchestration, prompt/context management, retrieval pipelines, vector stores, and tool integration (including emerging protocols like MCP).
Responsible AI Frameworks: Define and enforce AI governance, risk, and safety frameworks (covering bias, data privacy, and model risk) aligned with regulatory requirements.
Team Leadership and Delivery: Mentoring and leading a team of AI engineers and architects, driving end-to-end delivery quality, technical governance boards, and production readiness.
Ecosystem Partnerships: Own technical relationships across major cloud AI ecosystems (Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, Anthropic, OpenAI).
Reusable Assets: Drive the creation of reusable accelerators, frameworks, and IP across client engagements

Required Skills And Experience

Clearance: Active UK SC Clearance is essential.
Experience: 10+ years in software, data engineering, or solution architecture, with at least 3-5 years focused specifically on applied AI/ML or Generative AI.
Hands-on GenAI Depth: Proven experience architecting solutions with frontier modelsincluding prompt engineering, fine-tuning, RAG, and agentic/multi-agent system design.
LLMOps / MLOps Grounding: Expertise in evaluation frameworks, observability, cost and latency optimization, guardrails, and safe deployment at scale.
Cloud and Model Ecosystems: Direct experience with major model providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google) and hyperscaler AI stacks (AWS Bedrock, Azure AI/OpenAI, Google Vertex AI).
AI Governance: Deep knowledge of Responsible AI, risk management, and regulatory frameworks (e.g., EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF).
Consulting Leadership: Proven experience in client-facing consulting, pre-sales technical leadership, and managing CxO-level stakeholders.
Engineering Fundamentals: Strong software engineering background (API design, microservices, cloud-native architecture, data pipelines).

Preferred / Desirable Skills

Experience with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI) and emerging tool protocols (e.g., Model Context Protocol / MCP).
Relevant certifications (e.g., Azure AI Engineer, AWS ML Specialty, Google Professional ML Engineer).

jobs.description:
Company Description

⚡️ Why Altium?

Altium is transforming the way electronics are designed and built. From startups to world’s technology giants, our digital platforms give more power to PCB designers, supply chain, and manufacturing, letting them collaborate as never before.

Constant innovation has created a transformative technology, unique in its space
More than 30,000 companies and 100,000 electronics engineers worldwide use Altium
We are growing, debt-free, and financially strong, with the resources to become #1 in the EDA industry

Job Description

Role Overview:

Senior Site Reliability Engineer ensures the reliability, availability, and performance of large-scale software systems through a blend of software engineering and systems administration. Key responsibilities involve automating operational tasks, improving observability, and contributing to incident management, while also collaborating with development and technology teams to build more reliable and scalable applications. 

Join Altium as a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to ensure the reliability and performance of the Altium Cloud Platforms.

Key Responsibilities

Understanding how an Altium Cloud Platform works
Pioneer improvements in observability, including logging, monitoring, and application performance management (APM), ensuring system reliability and proactive issue detection.
Develop and implement reliability frameworks and patterns that standardize and elevate the resilience of our SaaS products across multiple regions and environments.
Cultivate a shared responsibility model where the SRE team collaborates with and educates engineering teams on reliability best practices.
Contribute to incident response and management, ensuring rapid resolution, clear stakeholder communication, and post-incident analysis for continuous improvement.
Participate in system design consulting, platform management, infrastructure upgrades and capacity planning.
Partner closely with engineering and development teams to enhance product stability, observability, and manageability through best practices in reliability engineering.
Partner closely with DevOps/Operations, drive automation initiatives, promote Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and streamline deployment processes to improve operational efficiency and scalability.
Champion Service-Oriented Organization (SOO) principles to ensure accountability and clarity in service ownership.

Qualifications

6+ years in SRE, DevOps or related role in a large-scale environment
Software development experience (ideally working with and as a .NET developer)
Strong understanding of SDLC, microservice and HA architecture
Observability - NewRelic, ELK, Grafana, PagerDuty, OTEL or similar
Experience with Kubernetes clusters in production setting, AWS, IOC
Experience with operational tasks
Knowledge of CI-CD tooling Jenkins, Gitlab, GitHub, ArgoCD or similar
Knowledge of IaaC Terraform, Ansible
Basic knowledge of networking fundamentals
Experience with relational databases (mysql, postgres) as a plus

Additional Information

Altium Limited, a part of the Renesas Group and headquartered in San Diego, California, is a global software company accelerating the pace of electronics innovation. We are redefining electronic product creation in a software-defined world with our industry-first cloud-based platform that unites every stakeholder and phase of electronics development.

From startups to world’s technology giants, our digital platforms give more power to PCB designers, supply chain, and manufacturing, letting them collaborate as never before. At Altium, our teams are empowered to innovate, collaborate globally, and help create the future of electronics development.

We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.

jobs.title: Software Developer (Cloud & Data)
jobs.description:
Job Description

What if you could do the kind of work the world needs?

At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.

WSP is looking for an experienced Software Developer (Cloud & Data) to join our industry-leading Intelligent Infrastructure team. We provide technical professional services to transport clients throughout the UK and overseas to deliver tangible value through technology enabled change.

Join us and make a real-world difference by helping to deliver crucial projects for public sector clients, such as using big data to help the DfT provide better rail services, helping road safety officers visualise accident data geospatially, or gathering vital transport planning data using AI-enabled traffic cameras that distinguish and count the different modes of transport.

As a WSP Software Developer (Cloud & Data), you will play a key role in technical delivery while also leading tasks within a team to provide quality assurance, consultancy, and advisory services on client-facing projects. In addition to challenging and stimulating projects, you will be able to access a range of benefits, including targeted professional development and training to help you grow and develop at WSP.

A Little More About Your Role…

Design, build and maintain secure, scalable software, cloud and data solutions using industry best practices, ensuring security and compliance.
Scope, estimate, and take ownership of delivery for assigned tasks and projects, managing workload and dependencies to deliver within agreed timeframes.
Engage with clients and stakeholders to understand their needs, capture requirements, and ensure a shared understanding of project objectives
Lead technical tasks and work packages, coordinating activities, managing dependencies and providing technical direction to ensure successful delivery of outcomes.
Perform quality assurance reviews of project documentation or consultancy deliverables, ensuring accuracy, clarity, and alignment with best practices and client requirements
Support and maintain new and legacy applications, cloud services and data platforms, ensuring timely and effective resolution of issues while maintaining clear communication with stakeholders.
Provide consultancy and advisory services, guiding clients on software engineering, cloud adoption, data architecture and technical best practices.
Input to the continuous improvement of practice and standards within the team
Maintain and develop your own expertise by staying current with emerging technologies, pursuing relevant certifications, and through continuous learning
Coach and mentor junior colleagues, providing guidance, support, and constructive feedback to help them develop their skills and confidence

Your Team…

This role sits within the Intelligent Infrastructure business and will form a key part of the growing Data, Architecture and Solutions Capability, which is our centre of excellence for digital skills. The Capability team provides a community of colleagues working in and around technology to help you deliver effectively and support your professional development through training, mentoring and opportunities to really stretch your capabilities.
You'll work as part of an Agile team of developers, testers, analysts and transport specialists to design, build, deploy and maintain cloud-based applications, data solutions and digital services. Using technologies such as Python, .NET, Azure, DevOps and AI capabilities enabled through our Microsoft partnership, you'll deliver innovative solutions that help make journeys greener, safer, cheaper and faster.
We operate a hybrid working policy and expect colleagues to spend time on client sites and collaborating with colleagues face-to-face, as well as working from a local office. We have offices across the UK.

What We Will Be Looking For You To Demonstrate…

Experience designing, building and supporting enterprise-scale applications and services using ASP.NET and Microsoft Azure, supported by relevant certifications and qualifications. Experience with Python would be highly beneficial.
Experience designing and implementing cloud-native solutions and data-driven applications, including integration, transformation and management of data within cloud environments
Experience working across the Azure platform, with the ability to independently deliver cloud-based solutions whether involving applications, data pipelines, DevOps tooling, automation, integration or other Azure services
Experience of semantic modelling, metadata management and enterprise data architecture, applying these practices to support scalable, governed and reusable data solutions.
Experience applying secure software development practices, including OWASP guidelines, identity and access management, secrets management and basic threat modelling.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to think creatively and develop practical solutions to complex technical challenges.
Experience working within Agile delivery teams and deploying applications and services through DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines in production environments.
Demonstrable experience of testing throughout the software delivery lifecycle, including unit, integration, ETL, regression and end-to-end testing.
Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with experience working directly with clients and customers to provide credible technical advice and guidance.
Experience conducting quality assurance activities and technical reviews to ensure the reliability, maintainability and compliance of software, cloud and data solutions.
Experience providing guidance and applying best practices in cloud architecture, data architecture and software engineering.
A degree in an analytical discipline such as Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, Data Science, Social Sciences, or equivalent industry experience.

Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.

Join our close-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 69,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world.

With us, you can. Apply today.

About Us

We are one of the world’s leading engineering and professional services firms. Our passionate people are united by the common purpose of creating positive, long-lasting impacts on the communities we serve through a culture of innovation, integrity, and inclusion. With over 11,000 professionals across the UK and Ireland, we are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

Work-life balance

At WSP, we understand that work is just one aspect of your life. It’s important to make time for you, your family, friends, interests and your community.

Our hybrid working policy offers the flexibility to work from home two days a week, while also providing opportunities to collaborate in our modern offices across the UK.

Inclusivity & Belonging

We welcome applicants with varied backgrounds and experiences. We enable rewarding careers by encouraging people to bring their whole and authentic selves to work so that our work represents the fullest spectrum of society. We celebrate integrity and treat people with respect, supporting each other and embracing a culture of inclusion and belonging at WSP. We have our employee resource groups bring together employees and allies with different backgrounds to promote a culture of inclusivity.

Health & Wellbeing

We are committed to supporting our people, giving you the tools to make improvements to your health and wellbeing through our Thrive programme.

Our Virtual GP service gives you access to an NHS or Irish Medical Council GP at a time and place that suits you – giving you peace of mind and quick access to medical advice when you need it most. We also provide reasonable workplace adjustments for those in need. Additionally, you can benefit from the Gymflex scheme, which offers up to 40% off annual gym memberships through our WSP flexible benefits program, as well as a comprehensive menopause support package.

Flex your time

To enhance work-life balance, WSP offers the “WSP My Hour,” allowing you to take one hour each day for personal activities, with the flexibility to make up the time earlier or later that day.

We also provide part-time and flexible working arrangements, the option to purchase additional leave, and the ability to use your bank holiday entitlement to suit you.

Your development

We understand the importance of development and training to you. That’s why we foster a supportive environment that invests in your growth, whether through training, mentoring, or Chartership.

#WeAreWSP

Here at WSP we positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of sex, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender reassignment, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy or maternity/paternity. As a Disability Confident leader, we will interview all disabled applicants who meet the essential criteria, please let us know if you require any workplace adjustments in support of your application.

What if you could do the kind of work the world needs?

At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.

WSP is looking for an experienced Software Developer (Cloud & Data) to join our industry-leading Intelligent Infrastructure team. We provide technical professional services to transport clients throughout the UK and overseas to deliver tangible value through technology enabled change.

Join us and make a real-world difference by helping to deliver crucial projects for public sector clients, such as using big data to help the DfT provide better rail services, helping road safety officers visualise accident data geospatially, or gathering vital transport planning data using AI-enabled traffic cameras that distinguish and count the different modes of transport.

As a WSP Software Developer (Cloud & Data), you will play a key role in technical delivery while also leading tasks within a team to provide quality assurance, consultancy, and advisory services on client-facing projects. Design, build and maintain secure, scalable software, cloud and data solutions using industry best practices, ensuring security and compliance.

Lead technical tasks and work packages, coordinating activities, managing dependencies and providing technical direction to ensure successful delivery of outcomes.

Experience of semantic modelling, metadata management and enterprise data architecture, applying these practices to support scalable, governed and reusable data solutions.

jobs.title: Client Technology - Engineering - Architecture
jobs.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The opportunity

We are looking for a candidate who will be part of the Architecture team within the EY Client Technology’s Technology Strategy and Architecture (TS&A) function. The candidate will be responsible for defining and delivering architectures and designs for business-critical global products and platforms, hosted in a variety of infrastructure/environments considering reusability, scalability and reliability in alignment with EY’s mission and strategy!

Your Key Responsibilities

Build relationships across the business to understand their requirements, strategy and help them build product/platform roadmaps, demonstrate architecture leadership to translate business requirements into architecture blueprints, as well as innovative and practical design (both high and low level).
Own the overall technology, architecture and design landscape of the product/platform from solutioning to delivery to adoption and sale phases.
Potentially lead a team of architects in a portfolio or large product, set the overall technology and architecture direction and own its end-to-end delivery in a lead architect’s capacity, along with providing constant architecture governance and guidance.
Solve complex problems in realms where solutions may not currently exist, necessitating the ideation and incubation of the new solutions/ways of working/technologies, technical feasibility and buy/build analysis, vendor product evaluations, proof of concepts (with hands-on) and presenting various options to the business with appropriate recommendations.
Work very closely with multi-disciplinary teams (e.g. engineering, platform, infosec) to deliver the envisioned architectures and design using optimized delivery approaches, in compliance to enterprise standards, practices, policies and guidelines.
Provide leadership in product delivery to build and consume reusable functional and technical assets. Identify, define and implement the reusable assets and standards.
Provide support to product and project managers in building the plans, forecast, estimations and costs for new as well as existing products/platforms, to build the appropriate balance between costs, risks and quality.
Provides coaching, mentoring and support to development teams during the delivery phase across the eco-system, frameworks and platforms. Ensure that the developed artifacts comply to envisioned architecture and design, expected quality, recommended standards/practices with code reviews and various levels of architecture, design and quality reviews.
Contribute to architecture and development standards/guidelines to promote optimization and consistency.
Have the ability to work across multiple projects with varied stakeholders. An architect sets architectural direction, builds consensus, mediates conflicts providing technical leadership and advisory services to the business. He/she anticipates needs and potential objections and helps to create an environment which solicits positive contributions from all participants.
Demonstrate good interpersonal communication and organizational skills that are required to operate as a leading member of global, distributed teams that deliver quality services and solutions.
Cultivate lasting relationships across business, IT and vendors / industry analysts to maintain insight into the broader enterprise as well as industry trends. Understand new trends and emerging technologies, and how they apply to EY. Evangelize and encourage the importance of technical quality, emerging technologies, sharing & experimentation across the org through mentoring, hackathons, communities etc

Skills And Attributes For Success

Led and governed a global team of solution architects and technical architects, driving the technology and architecture landscape of large and complex portfolio of products/solutions/projects, achieving success in its implementation and adoption.
Architecture leadership skills, advanced understanding and practical experience of architecture role with proven track record in a complex, large-scale (team size in hundreds), global product/platform (user base in hundreds, thousands and more) ecosystem across the entire lifecycle from planning to delivery to support/operations and adoption. Proven ability to work with business as well as perform hands-on technology delivery work in architect’s capacity using various architecture and design tools.
Hands-on deep experience of one or more specialization of solution and technical architecture role e.g. application, infrastructure/cloud, integration, data and security architectures and successful delivery of functional as well as non-functional aspects of a product/platform, using native cloud, full-stack application, data, security, AI technologies, following Agile, DevSecOps and automation practices.
Expert-level skills in defining, designing and developing distributed and scalable products and platforms, using reusable domain-specific composable (micro) services running on containers on multi-platform/hybrid clouds (Microsoft Azure preferred) using the respective cloud IaaS/PaaS/SaaS services.
Expert-level skills in multiple application programming and scripting languages (JavaScript, .NET, Java, Python, C++, etc), SQL and noSQL databases, Bigdata and its processing, Data analytics and Machine Learning, Industry’s recommended authentication/authorization technologies. Microsoft and Azure based technology skills are preferred.
Ability to adopt and relate new technologies to the set of problems we face at EY while adhering to security and other EY standards.
Understanding of business and organizational strategy and ability to communicate solutions, ideas, suggestions to business partners effectively and comprehensibly.
In-depth knowledge of various design patterns, and architectural styles (e.g., traditional application based as well as microservices and containers, event-driven, data streaming, data transformations and analytics)
Strong collaboration, analytical, interpersonal and communication abilities.

Ideally, you’ll also

Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent in Engineering, Computer Science, IT, Mathematics, Economics.
15+ years overall IT industry experience, with 5+ years in a solution or technical architect role using service and hosting solutions such as private/public cloud IaaS, PaaS and SaaS platforms.
Achieved one or more of the typical solution and technical architecture certifications e.g. Microsoft, MS Azure Certification, TOGAF, AWS Cloud Certified, Pivotal, CISSIP, Zachman, ITIL, Cisco, (ISC)2, CEH, SAFe, PMI, and SAP etc
Thought leadership - presenting ideas, products, concept papers to varied audiences, building point of views and presenting them in industry forums/event.
Experience in designing and implementation of business use-cases using low-code/no-code, Generative AI, data reporting, data management and governance technologies, mobile applications, deep cloud security concepts.

What We Look For

We want people who are self-starters, who can take initiative and get things done. If you can think critically and creatively to solve problems, you will excel. You should be comfortable working with culturally diverse outsourced on/offshore team members which means you may need to work outside of the normal working hours in your time zone to partner with other Client Technology staff globally. Some travel may also be required, both domestic and international.

This job posting relates to an existing vacancy within our organization.

What We Offer You (Canada)

We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. In addition, our Total Rewards package allows you to decide which benefits are right for you and which ones help you create a solid foundation for your future. Our Total Rewards package includes a discretionary bonus program, a comprehensive medical, prescription drug and dental coverage plan, a defined contribution pension plan, a great vacation policy plus firm paid days that allow you to enjoy longer long weekends throughout the year, statutory holidays and paid personal days (based on province of residence), and a range of exciting programs and benefits designed to support your physical, financial and social well-being. Plus, we offer:

Support and coaching from some of the most engaging colleagues in the industry
Learning opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

To help create the best experience during the recruitment process, please describe any accommodation you may need.

Inclusiveness at EY

Inclusiveness is at the heart of who we are and how we work. We’re committed to fostering an environment where differences are valued, policies and practices are equitable, and our people feel a sense of belonging. We embrace diversity and are committed to combating systemic racism, advancing gender equity and women in leadership, advocating for the 2SLGBTQIA+ community, promoting our neuroinclusion and accessibility initiatives, and are dedicated to amplifying the voices of Indigenous peoples (First Nations, Inuit, and Métis) nationally as we strive towards reconciliation. Our diverse experiences, abilities, backgrounds, and perspectives make our people unique and help guide us. Because when people feel free to be their authentic selves at work, they bring their best and are empowered to build a better working world.

Learn about our commitment to Inclusiveness at https://www.ey.com/en_ca/about-us/corporate-responsibility/equity

What We Offer You

The compensation ranges below are provided in order to comply with United States pay transparency laws. Other geographies will follow their local salary guidelines, which may not be a direct conversion of published US salary ranges. At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job in all geographic locations in the US is $138,200 to $266,000. The base salary range for New York City Metro Area, Washington State and California (excluding Sacramento) is $165,800 to $302,300. Individual salaries within those ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.
Join us in our team-led and leader-enabled hybrid model. Our expectation is for most people in external, client serving roles to work together in person 40-60% of the time over the course of an engagement, project or year.
Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

EY accepts applications for this position on an on-going basis.

jobs.title: Fullstack Developer (.NET + Angular)
jobs.description:
Dołącz do naszego zespołu, gdzie technologia spotyka się z realnym biznesem. Jako Fullstack Developer będziesz mieć kluczowy wpływ na rozwój naszych flagowych produktów e-commerce (e-Sklep, e-Sale, B2B). Szukamy osoby, która sprawnie porusza się zarówno w świecie backendu, jak i frontendu, potrafi przełożyć potrzeby biznesowe na wydajny kod i nie boi się korzystać z nowoczesnych narzędzi wspierających programowanie (AI).

Profil stanowiska

Minimum 3 lata (Mid) lub 5 lat (Senior) doświadczenia w tworzeniu aplikacji z wykorzystaniem C# oraz Angular
Swoboda w pracy z SQL, .NET Framework 4.7, .NET Core, WebAPI oraz systemem kontroli wersji Git
Samodzielność w rozwiązywaniu problemów technicznych i proaktywne podejście do wyzwań biznesowych
Znajomość języka angielskiego na poziomie pozwalającym na swobodne korzystanie z dokumentacji technicznej
Wiedza na temat specyfiki e-commerce oraz doświadczenie w pracy w metodologiach zwinnych
Mile widziana umiejętność pracy z narzędziami takimi jak Claude, Gemini czy Copilot – cenimy efektywność, jaką dają w codziennej pracy

Twoje zadania

Tworzenie wysokiej jakości kodu dla części backendowej i frontendowej naszych rozwiązań e-commerce
Aktywny udział w pracach zespołu scrumowego nad rozwojem platform e-Sklep, e-Sale i B2B
Zapewnienie stabilności rozwiązań poprzez przygotowywanie testów jednostkowych
Współpraca przy wdrażaniu rozwiązań w środowisku Kubernetes, Docker oraz IIS

Dla Ciebie

Prywatna opieka medyczna w Allianz - dostęp do specjalistów i badań diagnostycznych dla Ciebie i Twoich najbliższych
System kafeteryjny - możesz wybrać pełne dofinansowanie do karty Multisport czy przeznaczyć środki na kulturę, wypoczynek lub sport i zakupy
Możliwość pracy w modelu hybrydowym po okresie wdrożenia (2 dni pracy zdalnej, 3 dni pracy z biura)
Możliwość korzystania z zaawansowanych narzędzi AI i Google Workspace
Współpraca z różnymi zespołami kompetencyjnymi, która pozwoli Ci na poznanie nowych technologii i poszerzenie wiedzy w obszarze IT
Profesjonalny rozwój zawodowy, realny wpływ na podejmowane decyzje biznesowe
Udogodnienia dla rowerzystów/ rowerzystek (stojaki, szatnie, rowerownie, stacja naprawcza), a dla tych, co do pracy docierają samochodem – naziemny i podziemny parking

R&D Team Manager

Develop AI agents and multi-step workflows that support ELSE digital service and asset management use cases.

Experience with agent evaluation, testing, verification, RAG, memory patterns, context man-agement, and agent control mechanisms.
Experience monitoring and optimizing AI systems for reliability, performance, and cost.
Understanding Microsoft enterprise security, compliance, and identity patterns, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams and mentor colleagues.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com
to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Job Title:

Senior SQA Engineer – Test Automation / Manual Testing

About us:

Accuris launched in May 2023 as a standalone company and was formerly known as S&P Global’s Engineering Solutions division. Accuris has been an integral part of the engineering ecosystem for more than 60 years and is valued for standards content and workflow solutions including Engineering Workbench, Goldfire, Haystack, and Parts Management Solutions.

You will collaborate closely with software developers, QA specialists, Product Owners, IT partners, and engineering stakeholders. The team values ownership, practical test automation, clear communication, continuous improvement, and proactive collaboration across disciplines.

The Impact:

As a Senior SQA Engineer, you will design software testing plans, create and execute manual and automated tests, and help ensure the quality of web applications and services throughout the full product lifecycle, including Production.

You will guide the team on when and how to automate effectively, influence testability during design and development phases, coordinate defect management, and provide clear test results, regression feedback, and quality insights to development teams.

Poland.

jobs.title: Forward-Deployed Data and AI Architect
jobs.description:
Our Applied AI Engineering team designs and builds solutions that create real, measurable value for our clients across data engineering, AI and ML workflows, and agentic AI. We often work in complex, regulated environments such as financial services. We are looking for a Forward-Deployed Architect to shape the technical direction of our solutions from day one, in the field.

As a Forward-Deployed Architect within EY's Applied AI Engineering team, you will work closely with clients and forward-deployed engineering teams, making architecture decisions that shape solutions from the first prototype across data engineering, AI and ML workflows, and agentic AI systems.

EY.AI: in this role, you will work in an environment where AI agents are part of the team and everyday project delivery. You will use solutions tailored to specific business areas to analyse data, generate recommendations and design solutions, helping teams move faster from analysis to action and create value for clients.

Your scope of duties

Embed with client and forward-deployed teams to shape the architecture of data and AI solutions from discovery through the first working prototype, across data processing, AI and ML workflows, and agentic systems.
Make fast, pragmatic technology and design decisions under ambiguity, choosing patterns that balance speed now with scalability later.
Define the target architecture and a credible path to production so validated prototypes can move seamlessly into the production build phase.
Ensure prototypes and solutions are built responsibly and securely from the start, with data handling, lineage, guardrails and compliance considerations identified early, including the EU AI Act, GDPR, DORA and model risk.
Rapidly evaluate and select tools, services and frameworks across data platforms, AI and ML, and agentic AI that fit the problem at hand.
Act as the technical translator between business intent and forward-deployed engineering teams.
Manage and grow the pool of project blueprints and accelerators.
Identify and communicate technical risk, cost and feasibility early to inform build, pivot or stop decisions.
Partner with client enterprise and solution architects to align delivery decisions with enterprise standards and reference architectures.
Present and defend the technical direction to senior client stakeholders.

Our requirements

A master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, and approximately 10+ years of software, data or AI engineering and architecture experience.
A track record of designing solutions across data, AI and ML, or agentic systems and taking them from concept towards production.
Strong architecture skills and working experience in at least one of the following stacks: Microsoft Azure, including Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry or Azure Machine Learning, Azure Functions, Azure Data Factory, Microsoft Fabric or Synapse; AWS, including Bedrock, SageMaker, Lambda or Glue; or Google Cloud, including Vertex AI, BigQuery or Dataflow, together with hands-on coding ability.
A strong grasp of data architecture, including pipelines, lakes, warehouses and governance, and of AI, GenAI and agentic patterns, including RAG, orchestration, evaluation and guardrails.
Experience making architecture decisions under time pressure and ambiguity, ideally in a consulting, product or forward-deployed setting.
Excellent communication skills with both technical and senior business audiences.

Ideally, you'll also have

Financial services or other regulated-industry experience, and familiarity with the governance landscape, including AML and KYC, model risk or SR 11-7, the EU AI Act, DORA and GDPR.
Breadth across data engineering, AI workflows and agentic AI, and experience bridging prototype and production by defining handoffs and target architectures.
A consulting or startup background.
A history of creating reusable patterns and accelerators.

What we offer

Innovate EY, unique programmes where you can create your own start-up using our know-how and funding.
A convenient hybrid working model.
Professional and financial support in obtaining recognised qualifications and certificates.
EY Badges, global certification of your competencies and the opportunity to earn an MBA title from the prestigious Hult International School of Business.
Career Counselor, professional, one-to-one guidance on career building and development.
Psycho-educational platform, a package of free consultations with specialists in the broad field of mental health and personal development and access to educational activities.
Benefit programme offering private healthcare with additional preventive examinations, life insurance, tickets, team sports, language learning platform, sports cards and much more, available online and offline.

Recruitment stages

Apply. If this is your first time applying, create your profile and add your CV.
Let's talk. You will meet with Talent Acquisition specialists and representatives of your future team.

About EY Poland

We are a global consulting firm, helping businesses, organisations and communities make the most of their potential. Our audit, consulting, legal, strategy, tax and transaction teams ask the nonobvious questions to find new answers to the complex challenges facing the world today.

We employ more than 390,000 exceptional people in over 150 countries around the world. In Poland there are over 7,000 of us, working in Warsaw, Gdansk, Katowice, Krakow, Lodz, Poznan, Rzeszow and Wroclaw.

We create amazing things together every day. We have the people, the development path and the training to help you grow fast, gaining experience on successive projects.

We care about the environment, not just the business. As part of our plan, we have reduced our global greenhouse gas emissions by 43% from a 2019 baseline.

EY is an equal opportunity employer. We value and promote diversity in the knowledge and experience of our community. We operate the Level Up Without Barriers programme, which supports employees with disabilities in achieving their career ambitions and dreams.

EY provides all applicants with equal opportunities in the recruitment process, regardless of gender, age, race, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or any other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable law.

jobs.title: Software Architect
jobs.description:
Vill du arbeta med avancerad mjukvaruarkitektur i en tekniskt ledande organisation? Hos oss får du en nyckelroll i att utveckla framtidens serviceverktyg och mjukvaruplattformar i nära samarbete med både interna team och internationella partners. Vi söker nu en Software Architect som vill kombinera teknisk spets med helhetsperspektiv.

Som Software Architect kommer du att arbeta med:

Ta fram kravbilder och design av mjukvaruarkitekturer på system-, nod- och modulnivå
Driva tekniska vägval, komponentval och bidra till roadmap för plattformar
Stötta utvecklingsteam genom vägledning, utbildning och tekniskt ledarskap
Delta i test, verifiering och releaseplanering av mjukvarulösningar
Utföra avancerad felsökning samt ha dialog med intressenter

Som Software Architect inom vår mjukvarugrupp med fokus på serviceverktyg har du en central roll i att utveckla, vidareutveckla och säkra kvaliteten på våra mjukvarulösningar och plattformar. Du arbetar genom hela utvecklingskedjan, från att skriva/analysera krav och omsätta dem till hållbara arkitekturlösningar, till att säkerställa implementation, verifiering och vidareutveckling.

Rollen innebär ett nära samarbete med utvecklare, designers och systemingenjörer, där du fungerar som en teknisk ledare och kunskapsbärare. Du bidrar till att skapa struktur och riktning i utvecklingsarbetet genom att definiera arkitekturprinciper, etablera standarder och driva kontinuerliga förbättringar.

Du har även en viktig roll i kontakten med andra delar av organisationen, såsom produktion, marknad, samt med övriga R&D. Genom denna samverkan säkerställer du att lösningarna möter både tekniska krav och verksamhetens behov.

Tjänsten passar dig som trivs med att arbeta både strategiskt och operativt, har en stark analytisk förmåga och vill ta ett stort ansvar i att forma framtidens mjukvarulösningar. Här får du möjlighet att påverka teknikval, driva innovation och bidra till att skapa effektiva och robusta system med höga krav på kvalitet, säkerhet och funktionalitet

Till tjänsten som Software Architect söker vi dig som har/är:

Civilingenjörsutbildning inom mjukvara eller motsvarande
Minst 5 års erfarenhet av fullstack med Windows-applikationer i C#, .NET och typescript/React
God kunskap i engelska tal och skrift, meriterande om du även har goda svenskkunskaper

För att lyckas i rollen har du god kommunikativ förmåga, både skriftligt och verbalt och trivs med att samarbeta med andra för att nå gemensamma mål. Samtidigt arbetar du självständigt och har förmågan att driva aktiviteter framåt hela vägen till måluppfyllelse.

Vilka är R&D Toyota Material Handling Europe?

Toyota Material Handling Europe är världsledande inom materialhantering och vi gör stora investeringar för att möta framtidens behov. På vår R&D-avdelning i Mjölby arbetar 300 medarbetare med utveckling av våra produkter och tjänster samt nya innovativa lösningar. På Toyota arbetar vi med ett helhetsperspektiv där medarbetarna har ansvar från koncept till färdig produkt.

På Toyota förenar vi klassisk konstruktion med modern teknik inom automation, IoT och AI. Vårt produktutbud sträcker sig från manuella handtruckar till förarlösa fordon med avancerad teknik. På R&D avdelningen arbetar vi med korta utvecklingscykler för att möta efterfrågan på en snabbt växande marknad.

Medarbetarna inom R&D beskriver våra chefer och ledare som inkluderande, närvarande och prestigelösa. Vi på Toyota är måna om att skapa ett familjärt arbetsklimat med möjlighet till personlig utveckling och goda karriärmöjligheter.

Din Framtid på Toyota Material Handling Europe

På Toyota Material Handling Europe strävar vi efter att vara en vänskaplig, trygg och framåtsträvande arbetsplats. Vår kultur bygger på Toyotas värdegrund, där respekt och omsorg är centrala i det dagliga arbetet. Vi arbetar aktivt för att öka mångfalden och ta vara på olikheter, vilket stärker vår konkurrenskraft.

För att skapa förutsättningar till en hållbar vardag erbjuder vi våra medarbetare flextid och möjlighet till distansarbete på deltid.

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

Team Bio:

ServiceNow’s Applied AI Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE)
team is where bold ideas meet transformative action. We partner with our most strategic customers to shape the future of enterprise AI. Together, we identify high-value opportunities, accelerate business outcomes, and build reusable AI-native solutions that advance the Now AI Platform.

Our mission:
We partner deeply with our customers to build intelligent, scalable AI solutions that solve their most mission-critical challenges. By embedding in real-world complexity, we deliver fast, iterate with purpose, and transform every success into reusable patterns that accelerate transformation across the Now Platform and the broader enterprise.

Why This Role Matters

Enterprises are raising the bar. AI initiatives must deliver business value—not just promise potential. That means taking cutting-edge LLM capabilities and turning them into resilient, secure, and scalable software.

As a Senior Forward Deployed Software Engineer (FDSE)
, you act as the CTO of the build—owning everything from backend services to LLM pipelines and front-end integrations. You partner with customers in the field to design, implement, and deliver solution-ready builds in agile sprints. Your software becomes the reference implementation for scalable GenAI in the enterprise. You codify patterns, shape internal tooling, and accelerate innovation—delivering systems that are battle-tested in production and scalable across industries.

You are a systems-minded, AI-native engineer who ships real software. You own the full stack—and are equally motivated by elegant APIs, intuitive UIs, and scalable orchestration pipelines. You think like a product-minded CTO, balancing creativity with pragmatism to deliver impact.

You embed deeply with customer teams, diagnose root problems, and architect AI-powered workflows that run at scale. You don’t just debug code—you debug systems, context, and customer pain points.

Build solution-ready LLM-enabled applications that span backend logic, data orchestration, and front-end UI
Operate in the field, working side-by-side with customers to adapt, deploy, and iterate in live environments
Codify reusable assets—libraries, prompts, scaffolds—to accelerate future engagements
Shape developer experience by sharing feedback with platform and product teams

Engineer with versatility: APIs, orchestration pipelines, vector DBs, LLM frameworks, UI components
Operate with agility: integrate with legacy systems, navigate ambiguity, ship safely at speed
Codify patterns: build scaffolds, SDKs, and documentation to scale success across customers
Influence platform: inform product strategy through field-tested insights and extensible code

Production-grade delivery: Your solution builds consistently convert to scaled deployments in production environments
Reusable impact: You author libraries, prompts, and scaffolds that power multiple deployments and projects
Platform influence: Your work shapes internal tooling and is integrated into platform roadmap and primitives
Velocity and precision: You move fast without breaking things—shaping resilient, secure systems in high-stakes contexts
Engineering leadership: You are trusted by architects, PMs, and customer teams to lead implementation from zero to one

Experience: In leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI’s potential impact on the function or industry
Relevant Experience: 10+ years of software engineering, including 2+ years building systems in customer-facing or embedded roles

Engineering depth: Strength in backend (Python, Node.js, Java), frontend (React, Angular), APIs (REST/GraphQL)
LLM tooling: Familiarity with LangChain, Semantic Kernel, prompt chaining, vector search, and context management
Performance & observability: Skilled in debugging distributed systems, tuning for latency, and implementing monitoring

Field readiness: Able to travel up to 30% to embed onsite and deliver where it matters

jobs.title: Senior Technical Architect
jobs.description:
Vi ser etter arkitekter som har jobbet med .NET og Azure i mange år, og som fortsatt vil skrive kode. Du går inn i kundeteam som arkitekt, med ansvar for løsningsarkitekturen i systemer som allerede er i drift.

Arbeidet

Kundene våre er mange og varierte, men ofte innenfor bransjene industri, B2B og helse. Noen er store organisasjoner med lange systemhistorier, andre er mindre virksomheter som bygger opp teknologisiden sin. Som arkitekt sitter du som regel hos kunden til daglig, men det er også plass til deg inne på vårt hovedkontor, og vi har generelt gode hjemmekontorløsninger.

Du går inn i et kundeteam som arkitekt, som regel som én av få fra Forte. Systemene har vanligvis vært i drift i mange år før du kommer, og du overtar et landskap andre har bygget. Ansvaret ditt er løsningsarkitekturen: integrasjoner, dataflyt, sikkerhet og skyplattform.

Tittelen på oppdraget varierer med kundens behov. I noen perioder jobber du mest med kode, i andre mest med arkitektur.

En stor del av oppdragene våre handler om modernisering. Eldre integrasjonsplattformer, løsninger som fortsatt kjører on-prem, .NET Framework, standardprodukter som er tilpasset så mye over så lang tid at de ikke lenger lar seg oppgradere. Oppgaven er å finne veien fra dagens situasjon til noe som holder i mange år fremover, og å gjennomføre den uten at driften stopper opp underveis.

Konkret betyr det at du

setter teknisk retning i teamet, og forklarer konsekvensene av veivalgene både til utviklerne og til dem som betaler for dem
designer og bygger integrasjoner, API-er og dataflyt i Azure, med Functions, Service Bus, API Management, AKS eller det som passer problemet
skriver kode og gjør kodegjennomganger
etablerer plattform, IaC og pipelines slik at resten av teamet kommer raskere frem
bidrar til at utviklerne rundt deg blir bedre, gjennom parprogrammering og gjennomganger mer enn gjennom presentasjoner
dokumenterer beslutninger slik at de holder også når du ikke er tilgjengelig
tar stilling til hvordan kodeassistenter og agenter brukes i teamet, og hva det betyr for arkitektur, kodekvalitet og gjennomganger

Hva rollen ikke er

Dette er ikke en virksomhetsarkitektrolle, og heller ikke en rådgiverrolle på siden av utviklingsarbeidet. Rollen innebærer ikke personalansvar. Har du beveget deg bort fra koden og trives med det, er dette sannsynligvis feil stilling, men vi har andre roller og hører gjerne fra deg om dem.

Du må ha

.NET og C# som primærplattform gjennom mange år, med nok tyngde til at du har sett hvordan valgene dine har stått seg over tid
Azure-erfaring fra produksjonsløsninger du selv har vært med på å bygge og drifte
erfaring som arkitekt eller tech lead i team der du fortsatt skrev kode
gode norskegenskaper både skriftlig og muntlig

Det teller positivt om du har

ledet et moderniseringsløp fra legacy til målbilde
bygget dataplattform eller datahub
jobbet praktisk med sikkerhet i design og implementasjon
erfaring med IaC (Bicep, Terraform) og CI/CD i Azure DevOps eller GitHub
brukt kodeassistenter i eget arbeid og gjort deg opp en mening om hvor de faktisk hjelper
dokumentert arkitektur med C4 eller tilsvarende
sertifiseringer som AZ-305, AZ-204 eller AZ-400

Du trenger ikke kjenne deg igjen i alt på denne listen for å søke.

Fagmiljøet

Arkitektene i Forte driver en guild og faste fagmøter. Innholdet lages av arkitektene selv, og temaene bestemmes av dem som ønsker å være en del av miljøet.

Vi forventer at du bidrar med sparring, mentoring og en presentasjon i blant, og vi setter av arbeidstid til det.

Hva kan vi tilby?

🌴 6 uker ferie

Du får 6 uker ferie, fra det andre året du er ansatt i Forte.

🧠 Sterkt fagmiljø

Hos oss finner du gode sparringspartnere i alt fra junior utviklere til erfarne arkitekter. Du får bidra til å påvirke faglig retning, og vi har både et eget arkitektakademi og fagmøter.

🩺 Gode forsikringsvilkår

Dekket privat helse- og reiseforsikring og gode pensjonsordninger.

🎉 Godt sosialt miljø

Vi finner alltid en unnskyldning til å samles - alt fra aktivitetesgrupper, turer og månedlige arrangementer.

👶 Full lønn i foreldrepermisjon

Du får selvfølgelig utbetalt full lønn i foreldrepermisjon.

📚 Faglig utvikling i arbeidstiden

Vi brenner for fag, og hos oss får du bruke arbeidstiden til å utvikle deg innenfor det du ønsker.

🤸 Dekket treningsavgift

Vi vet at trening kan bidra til å fremme bedre helse. Forte dekker treningsavgift for opp til 800,- per måned.

Vi er Forte og vi er et europeisk konsulentselskap. Navnet vårt betyr styrke, og det er akkurat det vi gir våre kunder. Styrken til å tilpasse seg. Til å handle. Til å vokse.

Vi hjelper våre kunder med å forbli relevante og realisere sitt fulle potensial - uansett hva fremtiden bringer. Vi kombinerer teknologi, strategi og brukeropplevelse for å gi deg det du trenger for å lede – ikke bare følge etter.

Vi drives av det som virkelig teller: Målbare resultater, verdi og varig relevans. Vi heier på kundene våre og strekker oss litt lenger for å skape resultater sammen. Med raushet og engasjement møter vi deg der du er, tilpasser oss dine behov og gir tydelig retning. Vi tar initiativ, handler raskt og er alltid et steg foran – fordi vi gir alt for at du skal lykkes.

As the Solution Architect & Technical Senior Manager
, you will take dual ownership of the overarching technical architecture and engineering execution for our flagship platform, AGIL CityAI. Because building global-scale smart cities requires massive ecosystem orchestration, this is a front-facing leadership position. You will act as the premier technical authority representing our department – navigating complex client landscapes, championing enterprise application architectures across web and mobile platforms before client-side engineering executives to secure formal design approvals, and aligning third-party capabilities with core platform objectives. Leading a high-performing engineering team through all phases of delivery, you must think on your feet, thrive under pressure, and translate unpredictable real-world engineering constraints into resilient, workflow-driven urban intelligence solutions.

Global Mobility & Deployment:

as required to directly lead and support international system rollouts and client site commissioning.

Experience & Core Enterprise Expertise:

with a proven track record in end-to-end application mapping.

that seamlessly unify urban planning, operations monitoring, real-time incident detection, automated incident management workflows, and performance reporting into a single, cohesive engine.

.

(supporting advanced predictive urban operations).

for spatial analysis and geographic visualization.

frameworks (e.g., React Native, Flutter, Swift, or Kotlin) to drive real-time operational alerts and field-engineer workflows.
Professional exposure or proficiency in 3D solutions
is a strong asset / good to have.

(e.g., Scrum, Kanban, Jira, Confluence) to govern sprint planning and execution.

and continuous integration/continuous deployment pipelines (CI/CD frameworks) to streamline release cycles across web and mobile environments.

Deep architectural and hands-on experience with modern full-stack web environments (JavaScript, AngularJS, ReactJS, Node.js).

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
🚀 **Senior Software Engineer Arıyoruz!**

Ingenium olarak ölçeklenebilir yazılım sistemleri, yapay zekâ uygulamaları ve cloud tabanlı ürünler geliştiren ekibimize katılacak deneyimli bir **Senior Software Engineer** arıyoruz.

Bu pozisyonda yalnızca geliştirme yapmak değil; sistem mimarisi, teknik kararlar, code quality, deployment süreçleri ve junior geliştiricilerin teknik gelişiminde aktif rol almak beklenmektedir.

# Aradığımız Nitelikler #

• Bilgisayar Mühendisliği, Yazılım Mühendisliği veya ilgili bölümlerden **mezun olmak**
• Tercihen **5+ yıl profesyonel yazılım geliştirme deneyimi**
• Production ortamında çalışan, ölçeklenebilir uygulamalar geliştirme ve sürdürme deneyimi
• **Rust** ile profesyonel veya ileri seviyede geliştirme deneyimi
• Algorithms, data structures, concurrency ve software design principles konularında güçlü teknik temel
• **System Design, distributed systems ve scalable architecture** konularında deneyim
• REST API ve servis tabanlı backend mimarilerinin tasarımı ve geliştirilmesinde deneyim
• **SQL, PostgreSQL** ve ilişkisel veritabanları konusunda güçlü bilgi; query optimization ve database design deneyimi
• **Git** tabanlı profesyonel development workflow'larına hakimiyet
• **Docker** ve container tabanlı production ortamlarında ileri seviye deneyim
• **CI/CD pipeline'larının** tasarlanması, kurulması ve yönetilmesi konusunda deneyim
• **AWS** üzerinde production sistemleri geliştirme, deploy etme ve yönetme deneyimi
• Cloud architecture, scalability, availability, monitoring ve security prensiplerine hakimiyet
• **LLM tabanlı uygulamaların** tasarlanması ve production ortamına alınması konusunda deneyim
• LLM API'leri, prompt engineering, structured outputs ve tool/function calling konularında deneyim
• Debugging, profiling, logging ve production troubleshooting konusunda güçlü yetkinlik
• Clean Code, SOLID, testing ve maintainable software development prensiplerine hakimiyet
• Code review süreçlerini yönetebilecek ve teknik standartların korunmasına katkı sağlayabilecek deneyim
• Teknik dokümantasyon ve uluslararası kaynaklarla rahat çalışabilecek seviyede İngilizce

# Tercih Sebebi Olabilecek Yetkinlikler #

• Büyük ölçekli veya yüksek trafikli sistemlerde çalışma deneyimi
• Rust ile production seviyesinde backend/service geliştirmiş olmak
• **Microservices ve distributed systems** mimarileriyle çalışmış olmak
• **Kubernetes** ve container orchestration deneyimi
• AWS üzerinde **EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, S3, RDS, CloudFront, IAM, CloudWatch** gibi servislerle çalışma deneyimi
• Infrastructure as Code konusunda Terraform veya benzeri araçlarla deneyim
• Redis, message queues ve event-driven architectures konusunda deneyim
• **RAG, embeddings, vector databases, AI agents, tool calling ve agentic workflows** konusunda production deneyimi
• LLM sistemlerinde evaluation, observability, latency ve maliyet optimizasyonu konusunda deneyim
• Automated testing, integration testing ve end-to-end testing süreçlerinde deneyim
• Application security ve secure coding konusunda bilgi
• Monitoring ve observability araçlarıyla production sistemlerini takip etme deneyimi
• Teknik liderlik, mentoring ve junior/mid-level geliştiricilerin gelişimine katkı sağlama deneyimi

# Rol ve Sorumluluklar #

• Ölçeklenebilir ve sürdürülebilir yazılım mimarileri tasarlamak
• Production seviyesinde yüksek kaliteli yazılım geliştirmek
• Teknik kararların ve architecture süreçlerinin oluşturulmasına katkı sağlamak
• AWS altyapısı, deployment ve CI/CD süreçlerinin geliştirilmesine katkıda bulunmak
• AI ve LLM tabanlı ürünlerin geliştirilmesi ve production'a alınmasında aktif rol almak
• Code review yapmak ve engineering standartlarının korunmasını sağlamak
• Performance, reliability ve security problemlerini analiz ederek çözmek
• Junior ve mid-level geliştiricilere teknik destek ve mentoring sağlamak

# Ingenium'da Seni Neler Bekliyor? #

Ingenium'da yalnızca bir iş değil; çalışanlarımızın profesyonel gelişimini, sağlığını ve yaşam kalitesini destekleyen güçlü bir çalışma ortamı sunuyoruz.

• 🏢 **İTÜ ARI Teknokent bünyesinde çalışma imkânı** ve Türkiye'nin önde gelen teknoloji ve inovasyon ekosistemlerinden birinin parçası olma fırsatı
• 🏥 **Özel sağlık sigortası**
• 🛡️ **Hayat sigortası**
• 🍽️ **Yemek kartı**
• 🏋️ **MultiSport üyeliği** ile geniş spor ve aktivite ağına erişim
• 💻 Pozisyona uygun modern donanım ve teknolojik ekipman desteği
• 📚 Eğitim, teknik kaynak ve profesyonel gelişim desteği
• 🚀 Ar-Ge, yapay zekâ ve yeni nesil yazılım teknolojileri üzerinde çalışma fırsatı
• 🤖 LLM, cloud, Rust ve modern yazılım altyapılarıyla gerçek ürünler geliştirme deneyimi
• 📈 Sorumluluk alabileceğin, etki yaratabileceğin ve şirketle birlikte kariyerini geliştirebileceğin bir çalışma ortamı
• 💡 Yeni fikirlerin, teknik inisiyatiflerin ve yenilikçi yaklaşımların desteklendiği mühendislik odaklı kültür
• 🤝 Deneyimli ekip üyeleriyle bilgi paylaşımı ve sürekli gelişim imkânı
• 🌐 Gerçek kullanıcılarla buluşan, büyük ölçekli ürünlerin geliştirme süreçlerinde aktif rol alma fırsatı

**Ingenium'da teknolojiyi yalnızca takip eden değil, üreten bir ekibin parçası olacaksın.**

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
🚀 **We’re Hiring: Senior Software Engineer**

Ingenium is looking for an experienced **Senior Software Engineer** to join our engineering team building scalable software systems, AI-powered applications, and cloud-native products.

This role goes beyond writing code. You will be expected to contribute to system architecture, technical decisions, engineering standards, production infrastructure, and the technical growth of other engineers.

# Requirements #

• **Bachelor’s degree** in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field
• Preferably **5+ years of professional software engineering experience**
• Proven experience building and maintaining scalable, production-grade applications
• Professional or advanced development experience with **Rust**
• Strong understanding of algorithms, data structures, concurrency, and software design principles
• Strong experience with **system design, distributed systems, and scalable architectures**
• Experience designing and developing REST APIs and service-oriented backend architectures
• Strong knowledge of **SQL and PostgreSQL**, including database design and query optimization
• Strong command of professional **Git-based development workflows**
• Advanced experience with **Docker** and containerized production environments
• Experience designing, building, and maintaining **CI/CD pipelines**
• Hands-on experience deploying and operating production systems on **AWS**
• Strong understanding of cloud architecture, scalability, availability, monitoring, and security
• Experience designing and deploying **LLM-powered applications** in production
• Hands-on experience with LLM APIs, prompt engineering, structured outputs, and tool/function calling
• Strong debugging, profiling, logging, and production troubleshooting skills
• Strong understanding of Clean Code, SOLID principles, testing, and maintainable software design
• Experience conducting code reviews and contributing to engineering standards
• Professional working proficiency in English for technical documentation and communication

# Nice to Have #

• Experience working with large-scale or high-traffic systems
• Production-grade backend/service development experience with Rust
• Experience with **microservices and distributed systems**
• Hands-on experience with **Kubernetes** and container orchestration
• Experience with AWS services such as **EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, S3, RDS, CloudFront, IAM, and CloudWatch**
• Infrastructure as Code experience with Terraform or similar technologies
• Experience with Redis, message queues, and event-driven architectures
• Production experience with **RAG, embeddings, vector databases, AI agents, tool calling, and agentic workflows**
• Experience with LLM evaluation, observability, latency optimization, and cost optimization
• Strong experience with automated, integration, and end-to-end testing
• Understanding of application security and secure coding practices
• Experience implementing monitoring and observability for production systems
• Previous technical leadership or mentoring experience

# Responsibilities #

• Design scalable, reliable, and maintainable software architectures
• Build and maintain production-grade software systems
• Drive and contribute to technical and architectural decisions
• Improve AWS infrastructure, deployment processes, and CI/CD pipelines
• Design and build AI and LLM-powered products for production environments
• Conduct code reviews and maintain high engineering standards
• Identify and resolve performance, reliability, and security issues
• Mentor junior and mid-level engineers and contribute to the overall technical growth of the team

# What We Offer at Ingenium #

At Ingenium, we offer more than just a job. We provide a workplace designed to support professional growth, well-being, and quality of life.

• 🏢 **Opportunity to work within the ITU ARI Teknokent ecosystem**, one of Türkiye's leading technology and innovation communities
• 🏥 **Private health insurance**
• 🛡️ **Life insurance**
• 🍽️ **Meal card**
• 🏋️ **MultiSport membership** with access to a wide network of sports and wellness facilities
• 💻 Modern hardware and technology equipment suited to your role
• 📚 Support for training, technical resources, and professional development
• 🚀 Opportunity to work on R&D, artificial intelligence, and next-generation software technologies
• 🤖 Hands-on experience building real products with LLMs, cloud technologies, Rust, and modern software infrastructure
• 📈 An environment where you can take ownership, make an impact, and grow your career alongside the company
• 💡 An engineering-driven culture that encourages new ideas, technical initiative, and innovation
• 🤝 Continuous learning and knowledge sharing alongside experienced team members
• 🌐 Opportunity to contribute directly to large-scale products used by real users

**At Ingenium, you'll be part of a team that doesn't just follow technology — we build it.**

jobs.title: Senior BPM Solution Architect
jobs.description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Being part of EY in Greece means being part of a team which has been announced as Top Employer for the third consecutive year, certified as a Great Place to Work for a second year in a row, and awarded as Best Workplace in Professional Services & Consulting for the first time!

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences through coaching and training programs as well as the use of advanced technology and AI. We’ll fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams

Join our continuously growing team, which employs over 2.600 professionals in Greece, to experience great flexibility under our hybrid operating model across our offices in Athens, Patras, and Thessaloniki and help to build a better working world.

The opportunity

As a Senior BPM Solution Architect, you will play a key role in driving the design and implementation of BPM solutions for our clients. Your deep knowledge and hands-on experience with low-code platforms will enable you to create scalable, robust, and efficient solutions that align with our clients' business objectives. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including business analysts, developers, and project managers, to ensure successful project delivery. This is a senior-level position that requires strong leadership abilities, technical expertise, and a customer-centric mindset.

Your key responsibilities

Collaborate with clients to understand their business processes, requirements, and objectives, and design BPM solutions that meet their needs using low-code platforms like Appian, Camunda, Power Platform, or other relevant tools.
Lead end-to-end solution architecture, including process design, data modeling, integration, and user experience, ensuring adherence to industry best practices and standards.
Provide technical leadership and guidance to development teams throughout the software development lifecycle, ensuring high-quality deliverables.
Stay up to date with the latest trends and advancements in BPM, low-code platforms, and related technologies, and assess their potential impact on our solution offerings.
Identify and mitigate technical risks, proactively addressing any challenges that may arise during solution implementation.
Conduct workshops, presentations, and demonstrations to showcase the capabilities and benefits of low-code platforms to teammates and internal stakeholders.

Skills and attributes for success

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Master's degree is a plus.
Minimum of 5 years of experience in software development, solution architecture, and implementation of BPM solutions.
Expertise in low-code platforms such as Appian, Camunda, Power Platform, or other relevant tools. Certification in these platforms is highly desirable.
Strong understanding of BPM methodologies, workflow automation, and business process optimization.
Proven experience in designing and implementing complex, enterprise-scale BPM solutions.
Solid understanding of relational database technologies.
Solid knowledge of integration technologies, APIs, and protocols.
Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to identify and resolve technical challenges effectively.
Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams and present solutions to stakeholders at all levels.
Ability to work on multiple projects simultaneously, prioritize tasks, and meet project deadlines.
BPM platforms (Appian/Camunda/Power Platform)
Relational databases (design/SQL/tuning)
Web APIs (SOAP/REST)
Tooling (GIT/JIRA/Azure DevOPS)
CI/CD (Azure/Jenkins/YAML)

Ideally, you’ll also

What we look for

Certified Associate Developer
Certified Senior Developer
Certified Lead Developer
Camunda Certified Consultant
Camunda Certified Developer

What We Offer

What we offer you  

Ability to Shape your Future with Confidence by:

Developing your professional growth:
You'll have unlimited access to educational platforms, EY Badges and EY Degrees, alongside support for certifications. You will experience personalized coaching and feedback, and gain exposure to international projects, through our expansive global network, empowering you to define and achieve your own success.
Dive into our innovative GenAI ecosystem, designed to enhance your EY journey and support your career growth. These advanced AI tools will empower you to focus on higher-value work and meaningful interactions, enriching your professional experience like never before.
Empowering your personal fulfilment: We focus on your financial, social, mental and physical wellbeing.
Our competitive rewards package, depending on your experience, includes cutting-edge technological equipment, ticket restaurant vouchers, a private health and life insurance scheme, income protection and an exclusive EY benefits club card that provides a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions.
Our flexible working arrangement (hybrid model) is defined based on your own preferences and team’s needs, and we enjoy other initiatives such as summer short Fridays and an EY Day Off.
Our commitment to a sustainable way of operating, encourages volunteerism, promotes sustainable practices and offers opportunities for you to create a positive societal impact.
Our pride lies in working at EY as one of the most recognized employers in Greece through our multiple awards received over the last 3 years (Top Employer, Great Place to Work and Best Workplace in Professional Services & Consulting).
Fueling an inclusive culture: We prioritize a diverse, equitable and inclusive environment, where you’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

jobs.description:
Job Description

About Brainsquare

For 26 years, Brainsquare has partnered with organisations to design, develop, integrate and manage critical IT applications. Our teams combine technical expertise with close collaboration and a practical approach to delivering reliable solutions.

Your mission

As a Senior Test Automation Engineer, you will help shape and execute the testing approach for a complex digital platform in a public sector environment. You will work with engineers, analysts and business stakeholders to make sure business logic, data flows and integrations work reliably across the platform.

This is a hands-on engineering role
. You will design and automate tests, investigate issues and help the team improve quality throughout delivery.

Your main tasks

Turn the test strategy into a practical test plan and automated test suites.
Test business logic, data integrity and end-to-end user workflows across APIs and microservices.
Validate API contracts and integrations, including interactions with external systems.
Build and maintain automated API and UI tests, and integrate them into CI/CD pipelines.
Perform or support performance, scalability and security testing.
Use monitoring and logging to investigate issues and improve test coverage.
Contribute your testing expertise in an agile team and share findings with technical and business stakeholders.

Job Requirements

What we are looking for in you

Substantial hands-on experience as a senior test engineer in complex application environments. You can define an approach and implement it yourself.
Strong experience with test automation, API testing and end-to-end testing.
Experience testing cloud-based solutions, microservices and integrations.
Working knowledge of CI/CD, version control and automated quality checks.
Experience with several relevant tools or approaches, such as Bruno, Cypress, JUnit, Cucumber, JMeter, Gatling, Grafana or Azure DevOps. We do not expect you to have used every tool on this list.
The ability to work closely with developers and business stakeholders, challenge assumptions and explain your findings clearly.
A completed short or long-cycle higher education degree in IT, as required for this assignment.
Very good English and a good working knowledge of Dutch or French.
Availability to work on site in Brussels around three days per week, alongside remote work.

Experience with Azure, contract testing, service virtualisation or test-driven development would be particularly relevant.

What We Offer To Employees

As a Brainsquare employee, you can count on a permanent contract, a competitive salary and benefits package, opportunities to develop your expertise, and support from colleagues across our technical community. We will discuss the package and mobility options with you based on your situation.

What We Offer To Freelancers

As a freelancer, you can expect a clear project briefing, direct communication throughout the selection and assignment, and collaboration with Brainsquare colleagues who understand the technical context of your work.

Why choose Brainsquare?

You will have room to make a practical contribution to software quality in a demanding environment. The work spans the full testing picture: from business rules and API contracts to automated delivery pipelines, performance and the reliability of the platform as a whole.

Ready to discuss the role? Apply with your CV and briefly describe in your cover letter one complex platform you have tested, including the test automation you designed or implemented.
