jobs.description:
Description

About Xe

Xe is a cross-border payments platform. We help SMEs and consumers in the US, UK, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand collect, convert, hold, and send money across markets. Each year, over 300 million people use Xe for currency information and over 350,000 use us to send money overseas.

Today, we're rebuilding the platform layer behind cross-border payments for corporate and consumer clients. We're small enough that your code ships fast and your decisions matter, and Euronet Worldwide (Nasdaq: EEFT) backs us so the problems stay real-scale.

About This Role

We're hiring a senior back-end engineer who owns real problems end-to-end and shapes how the team builds, from API design and data modeling through to service implementation, production reliability, and launch. You already use AI as part of how you think, build, test, and ship.

You'll write code that moves money in production, design and modernize the backend services the platform runs on, and lead delivery of new capability as Xe rebuilds its platform layer. You'll work in a small team with direct access to product, compliance, and operations, own architecture in your domain, lead design reviews, mentor mid-level engineers, and partner with architects and team leads on cross-domain decisions.

What You'll Do

Design and own backend services that move money and manage multi-currency balances across a range of domains, including onboarding, KYC and KYB, payment initiation, FX, settlement, and other supporting services.
Lead cross-functional delivery with product, compliance, and operations from problem framing through launch.
Lead the build of the partner integrations and settlement infrastructure your domain depends on.
Own production health for your domain, including reliability, observability, on-call, and incident response.
Lead design reviews, set technical direction for your domain, and mentor mid-level engineers.
Use agentic coding tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent) daily across the SDLC, and lead modernization from legacy services into the modern stack alongside architects and team leads in your domain.

What We're Looking For

Must-have

6 to 10+ years building production backend services, end-to-end.
Strong backend proficiency in C# / .NET preferred; other OOP languages welcome (Java, Kotlin, Go, or equivalent).
SQL and relational database fundamentals.
Writing and maintaining tests.
Daily use of agentic coding tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent) across the SDLC.
Production experience with AWS, including hands-on deployment, CI/CD pipelines and modern deployment practices, and native services such as SQS, DynamoDB, S3, ECS, and Lambda.
Strong system design and architecture experience, including service-oriented or microservices and event-driven patterns.
Payments, FX, or regulated-industry experience.
Track record of technical leadership: mentoring engineers, leading design reviews, and making architecture decisions in your domain.
Strong written and verbal communication.

Nice-to-have

Experience with ledgers, double-entry accounting, or other financial-data systems.
Experience hiring, interviewing, or onboarding engineers.
Experience leading modernization or platform migrations.
Experience with caching solutions like Memcached or Redis.
Experience using project management and documentation tools like Jira and Confluence.
Knowledge of API testing tools such as Postman or Bruno.
Writing automated tests alongside development with AI tools (Claude Code or equivalent).

Perks & Benefits

Annual performance-related rewards: performance-based annual bonus
Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP): open to all employees
Car allowance: monthly car allowance (subject to Direction Level)
Meal vouchers: 8€ per working day
Preferential currency exchange rates: exclusive rates for employees
Money transfer discounts: special discounts on transfers
Annual salary review: performance-based process
Hybrid working model: 2 days per week WFH with flexible scheduling
Extended vacation allowance: 25-30 days annual leave
Extra bank holidays: additional company-recognised holidays
Birthday off: fully paid day off
Annual employee recognition events: HEROES awards & seniority recognitions
Annual social events: end-of-year celebration & regional/departmental gatherings
Seasonal celebrations: Halloween, New Year, Christmas, and other festivities
Volunteer days & CSR initiatives: Save the Children, environmental actions, food bank donations, and more
Employee wellness weeks: global and local wellbeing activities
Leadership training: internal and external learning opportunities

jobs.description:
About BizAway

Here at BizAway, we Deliver the Future of Travel. 😎

We are a solid international company with strong ambitions and great expertise. With a focus on sustainability 🌱, on a daily basis we support companies enabling them to improve their travel management through our constantly evolving services and solutions, always characterized by our tech attitude and smart and innovative processes. 🚀

We know that success comes from People and deserves to be recognized. 👫 Proactivity and Reliability, Kind collaboration, and communication are the core values of our Solution Culture.

If you like challenges and would love to be part of one of the fastest-growing B2B scale-ups, then BizAway is the company you have been looking for. 🤩

We are looking for

We are looking for a driven and enthusiastic Solutions Architect (m/w/d)
, to become the technical right-hand of our Account Executives during the sales cycle and help enterprise customers design scalable, maintainable, and high-impact integrations.

If you are passionate about solving complex integration challenges, balancing customer needs with product scalability, and translating technical conversations into commercial wins, you belong here.

Who You Are

You are a Trusted Technical Advisor: You know how to guide IT, Security, Finance, and Engineering stakeholders through complex technical conversations with confidence and clarity.
You are a Strategic Problem Solver: You don't just say “yes” to every customer request — you evaluate impact, scalability, ROI, and long-term maintainability before proposing solutions.

You are an Integration Expert: You are deeply familiar with APIs, webhooks, SSO, middleware, and modern integration architectures, and you know how to design lightweight solutions that unblock deals fast.
You are a Collaborative Partner: You work seamlessly across Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to ensure smooth delivery and long-term customer value.

6+ years of experience in customer-facing technical roles such as Solutions Engineer, Solutions Architect, Integration Consultant, or Technical Account Manager in a B2B SaaS environment

Experience working alongside Account Executives in quota-driven or technical-win-rate environments
Excellent presentation and stakeholder-management skills, including experience with CIOs, IT Directors, and Finance leaders

jobs.description:
Platform Support & Onboarding Engineer

We built Boehringer Ingelheim’s Enterprise Data Platform to maximize the value of our data and foster a more data-driven culture across the organization. As part of the Platform Support & Onboarding team, you will play a key role in helping product teams successfully adopt and leverage the platform while ensuring a seamless experience throughout their data and software delivery journey. In this role, you will combine platform consultancy, technical support, software development, and stakeholder engagement. You will guide teams through onboarding activities, help them design and implement solutions using platform services, and contribute directly to the evolution of the Onboarding Hub, our AI-powered onboarding and enablement product. Through automation, integrations, and self-service capabilities, you will help simplify how users discover, access, and operate services across the Enterprise Data Platform ecosystem.

Tasks and responsibilities

Act as a key technical contact for onboarding new product delivery teams to the Enterprise Data Platform, supporting platform adoption and helping teams make effective use of available services

Collaborate with product teams, solution architects, and engineering teams to design and implement solutions using Enterprise Data Platform capabilities, including cloud services, data platforms, analytics, AI services, CI/CD pipelines, and developer tooling

Contribute to architecture reviews and provide recommendations to ensure solutions align with platform standards, security requirements, and engineering best practices

Provide technical support and consultancy to platform users, troubleshooting issues, coordinating escalations where needed, and working with platform engineering teams to support resolution

Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of the Onboarding Hub and related platform products, delivering new functionality, AI-powered experiences, workflow automation, and self-service capabilities

Design and implement integrations with enterprise systems and services, including Jira, ServiceNow, Confluence, cloud platforms, identity management solutions, and internal data platform services

Support software releases and deployments across development, testing, and production environments to ensure reliability and smooth adoption of new features

Identify opportunities to improve user experience and platform adoption through automation, process improvements, AI-assisted solutions, and enhanced onboarding experiences

Collaborate with platform engineering and development teams to share user feedback and contribute to platform enhancements and product improvements

Create technical documentation, onboarding materials, and knowledge-sharing content, and support training sessions and enablement activities for the wider user community

Requirements 

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field

4-5 years of experience in Software Engineering, Platform Engineering, Technical Consulting, Developer Enablement, or a similar technical role

Hands-on experience developing applications and services using Python and modern software engineering practices

Strong knowledge of REST APIs, microservices, and system integrations

Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS and/or Azure

Experience with SQL and modern data platforms, ideally within analytics or data engineering environments

Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Git, automated deployments, and DevOps practices

Experience integrating enterprise applications and tools such as Jira, Confluence, ServiceNow, identity management platforms, or similar solutions

Exposure to AI-enabled applications, workflow automation, self-service platforms, or developer productivity solutions

Experience working in Agile development environments and collaborating with cross-functional engineering teams

Strong communication skills and the ability to engage effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Professional proficiency in English

#IamBoehringerIngelheim because…

We are continuously working to design the best experience for you. Here are some examples of how we will take care of you:

Flexible working conditions

Life and accident insurance

Health insurance at a competitive price

Investment in your learning and development

Gym membership discounts

If you have read this far, what are you waiting for to apply? We want to know more about you!

Our Company

Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,300 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com.

Why Boehringer Ingelheim?

With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.
Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.
Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.

Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com

jobs.title: QA Engineer (Senior)
jobs.description:
Description

About Xe

Xe is a cross-border payments platform. We help SMEs and consumers in the US, UK, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand collect, convert, hold, and send money across markets. Each year, over 300 million people use Xe for currency information and over 350,000 use us to send money overseas.

Today, we're rebuilding the platform layer behind cross-border payments for corporate and consumer clients. We're small enough that your code ships fast and your decisions matter, and Euronet Worldwide (Nasdaq: EEFT) backs us so the problems stay real-scale.

About This Role

We're hiring a senior QA engineer who owns quality end-to-end and shapes how the team tests, from test design and automation infrastructure through to release gating and production observability. You already use AI as part of how you think, build, test, and ship.

You'll catch problems before code that moves money hits production, design the test automation other engineers depend on, and lead modernization of the test estate as new capability ships. You'll work in a small team with direct access to engineering, product, and compliance, own quality strategy for your domain, lead test architecture decisions, mentor mid-level QA engineers, and partner with architects and team leads on cross-domain quality decisions.

What You'll Do

Design and own integration test harnesses and contract tests for the flows that move money, across a range of domains and the partner APIs behind them.
Lead the design of the test automation that gates code into production, across onboarding, KYC and KYB, payment initiation, FX, settlement, and other supporting flows.
Set the balance of manual and automated testing for your domain: write test cases, run manual tests where they are the right tool, and lead automation in Playwright and equivalent frameworks.
Own CI/CD quality strategy for your domain (release-blocking signals, flaky-test triage, test infrastructure health), lead production incident investigation, and translate findings into automated tests and process improvements.
Lead design reviews of test architecture, set quality direction for your domain, and mentor mid-level QA engineers.
Use agentic coding tools and AI test tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent; test generation, eval frameworks, or equivalent) daily, and lead the build of the test estate for new capability on the modern stack.

What We're Looking For

Must-have

6 to 10+ years building production test automation, end-to-end.
Strong test automation skills in JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, or C#, including test framework design, system design, and test architecture experience.
SQL and relational database fundamentals (for test data, validation, and debugging).
API testing (Postman, Bruno, or equivalent) and UI automation (Playwright, Cypress, or equivalent).
Functional and non-functional testing principles (reliability and security) and disciplined defect management, with hands-on performance, load, or resilience testing (k6, JMeter, or equivalent).
Comfortable generating test cases and running manual tests where they are the right tool, alongside building automated coverage.
Daily use of agentic coding tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent) and AI test tools (test generation, eval frameworks, or equivalent) across the SDLC.
Production experience with AWS in a development or test context, and CI/CD pipeline ownership (GitHub Actions or equivalent), including building release gates.
Payments, FX, or regulated-industry experience.
Track record of QA technical leadership: setting test architecture, leading code reviews of test automation, and making quality decisions in your domain.
Strong written and verbal communication.

Nice-to-have

Experience with contract testing for partner integrations (Pact or equivalent).
Experience testing Windows client applications.
Mobile app test automation.
Experience leading modernization of test estates or quality programs.

Perks & Benefits

Annual performance-related rewards: performance-based annual bonus
Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP): open to all employees
Car allowance: monthly car allowance (subject to Direction Level)
Meal vouchers: 8€ per working day
Preferential currency exchange rates: exclusive rates for employees
Money transfer discounts: special discounts on transfers
Annual salary review: performance-based process
Hybrid working model: 2 days per week WFH with flexible scheduling
Extended vacation allowance: 25-30 days annual leave
Extra bank holidays: additional company-recognised holidays
Birthday off: fully paid day off
Annual employee recognition events: HEROES awards & seniority recognitions
Annual social events: end-of-year celebration & regional/departmental gatherings
Seasonal celebrations: Halloween, New Year, Christmas, and other festivities
Volunteer days & CSR initiatives: Save the Children, environmental actions, food bank donations, and more
Employee wellness weeks: global and local wellbeing activities
Leadership training: internal and external learning opportunities
Cross-functional project opportunities: available based on skills and project needs
Internal & international mobility: relocation support and coaching for career development

XE offers a competitive salary and benefits package. The reasonable estimated pay for this role ranges from 55,000 EUR to 65,000 EUR. Actual compensation is based upon factors such as the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience.

Application Security Engineer (DevSecOps) | Híbrido Portugal

Procuramos um Application Security Engineer para integrar a área de segurança de um grupo europeu de referência no setor da mobilidade e infraestruturas, num ambiente Java e/ou .NET com cloud AWS e/ou Azure.

🎯 O desafio

A organização quer levar a segurança para o início do ciclo de desenvolvimento, em vez de a tratar no fim. O teu papel é garantir que as equipas desenham e escrevem código seguro por defeito, coordenar pentests e avaliações de vulnerabilidades, e apoiar tecnicamente a remediação até ao encerramento das recomendações.

🛠️ Responsabilidades

Definir e promover práticas de Secure SDLC, integrando requisitos de segurança no ciclo de desenvolvimento
Participar em revisões de arquitetura e conduzir sessões de threat modelling
Analisar resultados de pentests, vulnerability assessments, SAST, DAST, dependency scanning e container scanning, classificando e priorizando findings
Apoiar as equipas de desenvolvimento na remediação e acompanhar planos de correção e respetivos SLAs
Coordenar pentests com fornecedores externos: definição de scope, validação de findings e seguimento até ao fecho
Integrar controlos de segurança nas pipelines CI/CD e automatizar verificações
Ministrar workshops de Secure Coding, promover OWASP Top 10 e criar Security Champions nas equipas
Definir métricas e indicadores de segurança aplicacional

✅ Requisitos

Experiência prévia em desenvolvimento de software e arquitetura de aplicações, com evolução para Application Security
Experiência sólida em pelo menos uma stack: Java (Spring Boot, REST APIs, Maven) ou C# (.NET Framework / .NET Core, ASP.NET)
Linux, shell scripting e hardening básico de sistemas
Conhecimentos de cloud (obrigatório), com deployments reais de aplicações, preferencialmente AWS e/ou Azure
OWASP Top 10, OWASP ASVS e boas práticas de Secure Coding
Threat modeling, authentication e authorization (OAuth2, OpenID Connect, JWT)
API security e secure API design
Criptografia aplicada (TLS, ciclo de vida de chaves e certificados, hashing seguro)
Gestão de segredos (secret stores, rotação, evitar segredos em código)
Experiência com ferramentas do tipo SonarQube, Checkmarx, Fortify, Veracode, Snyk, Dependabot, OWASP ZAP, Burp Suite ou Trivy
Capacidade de influenciar sem autoridade hierárquica e de formar equipas de desenvolvimento

🤩 Valorizamos

Frontend Angular (JavaScript, TypeScript)
Experiência noutras clouds (ex. Google Cloud), considerada relevante e transferível

📍 Porque este projeto

Projeto de longa duração, a full time, com impacto direto na maturidade de segurança aplicacional de toda a organização e visibilidade transversal junto das equipas de arquitetura, desenvolvimento, operações e segurança corporativa. Não é um papel de auditoria, é um papel de construção.

Se gostas de estar dentro do código e ao mesmo tempo de mudar a forma como as equipas trabalham, este é o teu lugar.

jobs.title: AI Solution Architect and Product Owner – Cost Value Engineering
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day

As the AI Solution Architect and Product Owner – Cost Value Engineering (CVE), you are the technical anchor of a newly launched, high-impact AI initiative within our global procurement and engineering function. You design and own the localized, high-performance architecture required to execute complex, end-to-end engineering AI solutions. Operating as the definitive bridge between our specialized business needs and Central IT’s secure environment, you govern the technical backlog, steer development, and architect the integrations that power our tools. You ensure our AI solutions are scalable, secure, and directly drive business value for our engineering community and beyond.

How You’ll Make An Impact

Establish & Own Local CVE AI Platform: Build and govern the dedicated environment hosting our specialized AI applications and intelligent agents.
Architect Specialized Integration: Connect Central IT’s secure LLMs to localized engineering databases and low-code platforms, maximizing component reuse.
Govern AI Deployments: Act as the technical tollgate for all releases. Ensure solutions meet Central IT standards and validate business ROI before launch.
Guide Decentralized Teams: Mentor business-driven use case teams. Translate complex engineering problems into actionable, logical agile sprints.
Enable Citizen Developers: Architect the foundational frameworks allowing domain experts to securely build, test, and deploy their own AI solutions.
Design Product Backlog: Translate macro-business requirements into clear technical deliverables and manage the delivery pipeline.
Drive AI Roadmap: Prioritize rapid, high-impact Proof of Concepts (POCs) to secure immediate wins, basing execution on technical feasibility and accurate effort estimation.

What You Bring

Master’s degree in computer science, IT Systems Engineering, or a highly relevant technical experience.
5+ years of technical delivery experience, with a proven track record in software engineering, architecture, and driving agile AI/ML product lifecycles.
Strong Product Ownership credentials, specifically managing complex requirements pipelines, backlog refinement, and sprint executions.
Technical command of deploying modern AI frameworks (RAG, multi-agent architectures) within strict enterprise security boundaries.
Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365 Copilot, responsible AI practices, governance frameworks, security, compliance, and value realization.
Experience with cloud, data, and analytics platforms (e.g., Snowflake, AWS, Azure, or Microsoft Fabric) and with data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, and data integration is a plus.
Strong programming experience with Python and SQL with knowledge in API connectivity and backend services from development through deployment.
Knowledge of LLM integration techniques, including prompt engineering, RAG architectures, embeddings, and fine-tuning approaches.
Supply chain and/or manufacturing knowledge is a plus.

About The Team

The Cost and Value Engineering (CVE) function is the driver of cost transparency and optimization for externally purchased material, components, and systems in the global Siemens Energy product portfolio. We are a diverse and agile team, which centrally supports all Siemens Energy business areas in achieving their goals with focus on competitiveness and profitability.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Analyze and model the application landscape with regards to business aspects and IT aspects (Business Domains, Business Capabilities, Functional Architecture and Design, Technical Architecture and Design, Infrastructure Architecture) to identify areas for improvement

Experience in data heavy architectures & Strong analytical skills combined with structural thinking

Because building global-scale smart cities requires massive ecosystem orchestration, this is a front-facing leadership position. You will act as the premier technical authority representing our department – navigating complex client landscapes, championing enterprise application architectures across web and mobile platforms before client-side engineering executives to secure formal design approvals, and aligning third-party capabilities with core platform objectives. Leading a high-performing engineering team through all phases of delivery, you must think on your feet, thrive under pressure, and translate unpredictable real-world engineering constraints into resilient, workflow-driven urban intelligence solutions.

Architectural Governance & Innovation:
Own the technical blueprint, application integrity, and continuous innovation of the core AGIL CityAI system, including its cross-platform web and mobile applications and modular microservices ecosystem.

Oversee the translation of diverse IoT, IT, and operational workflows into real-time analytical and operational capabilities within the unified AGIL CityAI engine.

Vendor Capability Management:
Drive alignment with existing system maintenance vendors, auditing their application frameworks and API scopes to establish clean data exchange structures with AGIL CityAI.
Design & Roadmap Documentation:
Formulate, review, and maintain high-level design (HLD) architecture diagrams, component specifications, and comprehensive data-flow maps.
System and Functional Testing Oversight:
Strategize, govern, and validate rigorous system-level, end-to-end (E2E), and user acceptance testing (UAT) frameworks across web and mobile deployments alongside clients, vendors, and internal ST Engineering project delivery teams.
Global Mobility & Deployment:
Travel and undertake short to mid-term overseas deployments
as required to directly lead and support international system rollouts and client site commissioning.

Qualifications and Experience

Experience & Core Enterprise Expertise:

8-12 years of professional experience in enterprise software architecture, core backend engineering, or distributed application development.
At least 3 years in a technical management or software engineering leadership capacity.
Strong technical and software architecture skills
with a proven track record in end-to-end application mapping.

that seamlessly unify urban planning, operations monitoring, real-time incident detection, automated incident management workflows, and performance reporting into a single, cohesive engine.

.

(supporting advanced predictive urban operations).

for spatial analysis and geographic visualization.

frameworks (e.g., React Native, Flutter, Swift, or Kotlin) to drive real-time operational alerts and field-engineer workflows.

is a strong asset / good to have.

and continuous integration/continuous deployment pipelines (CI/CD frameworks) to streamline release cycles across web and mobile environments.

Deep architectural and hands-on experience with modern full-stack web environments (JavaScript, AngularJS, ReactJS, Node.js).

new_jobs.description:
Application Security Engineer (DevSecOps) | Híbrido Portugal

Procuramos um Application Security Engineer para integrar a área de segurança de um grupo europeu de referência no setor da mobilidade e infraestruturas, num ambiente Java e/ou .NET com cloud AWS e/ou Azure.

🎯 O desafio

A organização quer levar a segurança para o início do ciclo de desenvolvimento, em vez de a tratar no fim. O teu papel é garantir que as equipas desenham e escrevem código seguro por defeito, coordenar pentests e avaliações de vulnerabilidades, e apoiar tecnicamente a remediação até ao encerramento das recomendações.

🛠️ Responsabilidades

Definir e promover práticas de Secure SDLC, integrando requisitos de segurança no ciclo de desenvolvimento
Participar em revisões de arquitetura e conduzir sessões de threat modelling
Analisar resultados de pentests, vulnerability assessments, SAST, DAST, dependency scanning e container scanning, classificando e priorizando findings
Apoiar as equipas de desenvolvimento na remediação e acompanhar planos de correção e respetivos SLAs
Coordenar pentests com fornecedores externos: definição de scope, validação de findings e seguimento até ao fecho
Integrar controlos de segurança nas pipelines CI/CD e automatizar verificações
Ministrar workshops de Secure Coding, promover OWASP Top 10 e criar Security Champions nas equipas
Definir métricas e indicadores de segurança aplicacional

✅ Requisitos

Experiência prévia em desenvolvimento de software e arquitetura de aplicações, com evolução para Application Security
Experiência sólida em pelo menos uma stack: Java (Spring Boot, REST APIs, Maven) ou C# (.NET Framework / .NET Core, ASP.NET)
Linux, shell scripting e hardening básico de sistemas
Conhecimentos de cloud (obrigatório), com deployments reais de aplicações, preferencialmente AWS e/ou Azure
OWASP Top 10, OWASP ASVS e boas práticas de Secure Coding
Threat modeling, authentication e authorization (OAuth2, OpenID Connect, JWT)
API security e secure API design
Criptografia aplicada (TLS, ciclo de vida de chaves e certificados, hashing seguro)
Gestão de segredos (secret stores, rotação, evitar segredos em código)
Experiência com ferramentas do tipo SonarQube, Checkmarx, Fortify, Veracode, Snyk, Dependabot, OWASP ZAP, Burp Suite ou Trivy
Capacidade de influenciar sem autoridade hierárquica e de formar equipas de desenvolvimento

🤩 Valorizamos

Frontend Angular (JavaScript, TypeScript)
Experiência noutras clouds (ex. Google Cloud), considerada relevante e transferível

📍 Porque este projeto

Projeto de longa duração, a full time, com impacto direto na maturidade de segurança aplicacional de toda a organização e visibilidade transversal junto das equipas de arquitetura, desenvolvimento, operações e segurança corporativa. Não é um papel de auditoria, é um papel de construção.

Se gostas de estar dentro do código e ao mesmo tempo de mudar a forma como as equipas trabalham, este é o teu lugar.
